purpose: Persistent motion/behavior library for the AI clone. Scene, background and wardrobe are intentionally excluded.

strategy.motion_source: All MASTER_BEHAVIOR_*.mp4 files discovered in SOURCE
strategy.future_growth: New approved motion clips named MASTER_BEHAVIOR_03.mp4, MASTER_BEHAVIOR_04.mp4, etc. are added automatically by the asset locator.

motion_rules: Preserve the same person; motion references never redefine identity.
Use natural blinking and eye saccades.
Use subtle breathing and shoulder/neck movement.
Do not inherit the original reference background, bed, room, captions, watermark or wardrobe as clone identity.
Do not treat a source scene as part of the clone. Background and environment are external layers.
Talking motion must coordinate lips, jaw, cheeks, gaze and micro head motion with the active speech audio.
